        /// <inheritdoc/>
        public override void Serialize(Stream stream)
        {
            // vpkstuff patch: passthrough — write the original block bytes back
            // exactly as they were on disk. The vmdl_c RERL rewrite path
            // (ModelSwapStage.CloneArmsSharedVmats, ModelSwapStage.RewriteResourceRerl)
            // only mutates RERL/DATA blocks; vertex + index buffers are
            // byte-stable across that round-trip. Without this, re-serialising
            // any mutated vmdl_c throws NotImplementedException and the RERL
            // rewrite never lands, leaving first-person arms translucent
            // (or, in the swap path, leaving the splice's vmdl pointing at
            // the source bundle's paths instead of the target slot's).
            if (Resource?.Reader is null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    "VBIB passthrough requires the source Resource's Reader to still be open.");
            var src = Resource.Reader.BaseStream;
            var savedPos = src.Position;
            try
            {
                src.Position = Offset;
                var remaining = (int)Size;
                Span<byte> buffer = stackalloc byte[4096];
                while (remaining > 0)
                {
                    var take = Math.Min(buffer.Length, remaining);
                    var slice = buffer[..take];
                    var n = src.Read(slice);
                    if (n <= 0)
                        throw new EndOfStreamException("Unexpected EOF reading VBIB source bytes.");
                    stream.Write(slice[..n]);
                    remaining -= n;
                }
            }
            finally { src.Position = savedPos; }
        }
